source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Find same-colored boundary bars, represented by contiguous edge runs.
    runs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for side in (0,w-1):
            c=g[r][side]
            if c==bg: continue
            lo=r
            while lo>0 and g[lo-1][side]==c: lo-=1
            hi=r
            while hi+1<h and g[hi+1][side]==c: hi+=1
            if hi-lo+1>=2 and (side==0 or side==w-1):
                item=(c,'v',side,lo,hi)
                if item not in runs: runs.append(item)
    for cidx in range(w):
        for side in (0,h-1):
            c=g[side][cidx]
            if c==bg: continue
            lo=cidx
            while lo>0 and g[side][lo-1]==c: lo-=1
            hi=cidx
            while hi+1<w and g[side][hi+1]==c: hi+=1
            if hi-lo+1>=2:
                item=(c,'h',side,lo,hi)
                if item not in runs: runs.append(item)
    # Pair the two bars sharing color and orientation.
    pairs=[]
    for i,a in enumerate(runs):
        for b in runs[i+1:]:
            if a[0]==b[0] and a[1]==b[1] and a[2]!=b[2]: pairs.append((a,b))
    if not pairs: return g
    a,b=pairs[0]; barcolor,axis=a[0],a[1]
    dotcolors=[v for v in Counter(x for row in g for x in row) if v not in (bg,barcolor)]
    if not dotcolors:return g
    # Each singleton marker aligned with a bar starts a ray; the matching offset
    # on the other bar is projected all the way across the grid.
    markers=[]
    counts=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=g[r][c]
            if color in (bg,barcolor) or counts[color]!=1: continue
            markers.append((r,c,color))
    for r,c,color in markers:
        for src,dst in ((a,b),(b,a)):
            _,ax,side,lo,hi=src
            _,_,dside,dlo,dhi=dst
            if ax=='h':
                if not (lo<=c<=hi) or r==side: continue
                offset=c-lo
                target=dlo+offset
                if target>dhi: continue
                # fill from source boundary inward, stopping at the marker
                step=1 if side==0 else -1
                rr=side+step
                while 0<=rr<h and rr!=r:
                    g[rr][c]=color; rr+=step
                if 0<=r<h and g[r][c]==color: g[r][c]=4
                # corresponding ray from the other boundary to the opposite edge
                dstep=1 if dside==0 else -1
                rr=dside+dstep
                while 0<=rr<h:
                    g[rr][target]=color; rr+=dstep
            else:
                if not (lo<=r<=hi) or c==side: continue
                offset=r-lo
                target=dlo+offset
                if target>dhi: continue
                step=1 if side==0 else -1
                cc=side+step
                while 0<=cc<w and cc!=c:
                    g[r][cc]=color; cc+=step
                if 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==color: g[r][c]=4
                dstep=1 if dside==0 else -1
                cc=dside+dstep
                while 0<=cc<w:
                    g[target][cc]=color; cc+=dstep
    return g
'''
